title: Glass Canopy
description: A shimmering piano-led dance track that blooms early into full dancefloor euphoria, then melts away into gentle, dreamlike chords and brushed percussion. Lush chord progressions carry the melody while a crisp TR-707 kit drives the groove, before the track gradually dissolves into soft, hazy textures.
